2608.13433.title: Algebraic Decomposition Theory for Transformer Length Generalization
2608.13433.paper_summary: Transformer-based language models are known to sometimes generalize to sequences longer than seen during training, but we lack a precise characterization of which tasks admit length generalization. It is not even known which regular languages transformers length-generalize on -- and this is a foundational class of languages. Our contributions are to establish the first complete characterization of which regular languages transformers length-generalize on and provide a decision algorithm running in polynomial time in the size of the language's syntactic monoid. These results rely on an effective characterization of the regular languages in C-RASP, a recently-established formalism that expresses which languages transformers length-generalize on. This characterization is challenging because classical tools like Krohn-Rhodes decomposition theory for finite semigroups are insufficient for C-RASP. Firstly, the basic building blocks of Krohn-Rhodes theory -- flip-flop and simple groups -- are not expressible in C-RASP. Secondly, the basic building block of C-RASP (unbounded counting) is not expressible by the finite semigroups of Krohn-Rhodes theory. Thus, length generalization on regular languages is controlled by an algebraic property that is invisible to classical finite decomposition theory. We generalize classical decomposition theory from finite semigroups to the infinite additive group on the integers, allowing us to characterize C-RASP in terms of iterated wreath products of the integers and derive a provable polynomial-time decision algorithm for regular language membership. Experiments across a broad test suite of regular languages confirm that our theory captures transformers' length-generalization behavior more accurately than existing classifications.
2608.13433.paper_summary_zh: 基於Transformer的語言模型已知有時能夠對訓練期間未見的更長序列進行泛化，但我們缺乏對哪些任務允許長度泛化的精確描述。甚至尚不清楚Transformer在哪些正則語言上進行長度泛化——而這是一個基礎的語言類別。我們的貢獻是建立了Transformer在哪些正則語言上進行長度泛化的第一個完整描述，並提供了一個在語言的語法單子大小上運行於多項式時間的決策算法。這些結果依賴於對C-RASP中正則語言的有效描述，C-RASP是一種最近建立的形式主義，用於表達Transformer在哪些語言上進行長度泛化。這種描述具有挑戰性，因為像Krohn-Rhodes分解理論這樣的傳統工具對於有限半群來說對C-RASP是不夠的。首先，Krohn-Rhodes理論的基本構建塊——翻轉-翻轉和簡單群——在C-RASP中是不可表達的。其次，C-RASP的基本構建塊（無界計數）無法由Krohn-Rhodes理論的有限半群來表達。因此，對正則語言的長度泛化是由一種對傳統有限分解理論來說是不可見的代數性質所控制的。我們將傳統的分解理論從有限半群推廣到整數上的無限加法群，這使我們能夠用整數的迭代花環積來描述C-RASP，並推導出一個可證明的多項式時間決策算法，用於正則語言的成員資格。對一個廣泛的正則語言測試套件進行的實驗確認，我們的理論比現有的分類更準確地捕捉了Transformer的長度泛化行為。
